text: 今天（30日），西藏吉隆“8·26”泥石流灾害新闻发布会在吉隆镇举行。会上介绍，灾害发生后，西藏迅速启动自治区自然灾害一级应急响应、自治区自然灾害一级救助应急响应，成立吉隆县“8·26”泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部和前方指挥部。财政部、应急管理部紧急拨付1.2亿元资金，国家发改委安排1亿元资金，支持抢险救灾和灾后应急恢复工作。目前，已动员组织解放军、武警、中国消防救援队、边防、公安以及中国安能等各方救援力量2141人，调派救援车辆269辆，救援装备3922套投入一线开展搜救工作。现在，水陆空三路并进挺进受灾核心区。（央视新闻）
text_en: Today (30th), a press conference on Tibet Gyirong's "8-26" mudslide disaster was held in Gyirong Town. It was stated that after the disaster, Tibet quickly activated Level I emergency response for natural disasters and Level I relief response, establishing the Gyirong County "8-26" mudslide disaster emergency rescue command and forward command. The Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated RMB 120 million, and the National Development and Reform Commission arranged RMB 100 million to support rescue and post-disaster recovery. To date, 2,141 rescue personnel from the PLA, armed police, China Fire and Rescue, border defense, public security, and China Anneng have been mobilized, with 269 rescue vehicles and 3,922 pieces of rescue equipment deployed to the front line for search efforts. Rescue operations are advancing via water, land, and air routes into the hardest-hit areas. (CCTV News)
